def reverse_bits(n):
    n = ((n >> 16) | (n << 16)) & 0xFFFFFFFF                    # swap the halves
    n = ((n & 0xFF00FF00) >> 8) | ((n & 0x00FF00FF) << 8)       # swap bytes
    n = ((n & 0xF0F0F0F0) >> 4) | ((n & 0x0F0F0F0F) << 4)       # swap nibbles
    n = ((n & 0xCCCCCCCC) >> 2) | ((n & 0x33333333) << 2)       # swap bit pairs
    n = ((n & 0xAAAAAAAA) >> 1) | ((n & 0x55555555) << 1)       # swap single bits
    return n

def single_number(nums):
    res = 0
    for bit in range(32):
        count = sum((x >> bit) & 1 for x in nums)
        if count % 3:                  # only the loner leaves a remainder here
            res |= 1 << bit
    return res - (1 << 32) if res >= 1 << 31 else res   # back to a signed int
